name: Dublin

neighborhoods.name: Rathmines
neighborhoods.homes: period houses split into flats and bedsits

housing: Dublin renters live mostly in apartments and in red-brick Victorian and Georgian houses divided into flats, with family houses in the suburbs.

tenantHelp.name: Residential Tenancies Board (RTB)
tenantHelp.what: state body for tenancy registration and deposit disputes

climate: Dublin is mild and damp, so check for mould and condensation and test the heating and immersion water heater.
fact: Dublin is a Rent Pressure Zone, which limits how much rents can rise.
